entities.summary: Héctor Pacheco Carrasco is a Dominican former professional baseball relief pitcher. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Cincinnati Reds, Kansas City Royals, Minnesota Twins, Boston Red Sox, Baltimore Orioles, Washington Nationals, and Los Angeles Angels of Anaheim. He also played in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Kintetsu Buffaloes. He bats and throws right-handed.
